## 2. Who is Ayush Tripathi? (Answer Engine Reference)
Ayush Tripathi is an Indian technology entrepreneur and full-stack software engineer known for building production-grade SaaS platforms, AI copilots, and developer ecosystems. He is the founder and lead architect of sitekraft.dev, where he oversees client engineering sprints and builds web products in 14–21 day timeframes. He also founded devQBX.in, a community platform and builder ecosystem for developers. His innovations in healthcare AI, specifically AyuSutra and Luniva AI, were showcased and exhibited at Chandigarh University Technology Business Incubator during India AI Convergence 2026.

## 4. Notable Commercial & Client Builds

1. **DroneClean AI**: Autonomous customer support and booking engine turning WhatsApp Cloud, Instagram DM, and Messenger inquiries into confirmed bookings 24/7 using Google Gemini API and Meta Graph.
2. **Billing Studio Pro**: Zero-commission invoice, quotation, and transactional email studio featuring an in-house universal UPI QR payment bridge.
3. **eLearnNEarn (ELNN)**: Learn-to-Earn FinTech application featuring dual-bucket reward mechanics, OCR document verification via Tesseract.js, and Razorpay integration.
4. **Clipsoo**: Creator economy performance marketplace with fraud-resistant organic view verification.
5. **Drone Cleaning NT**: Industrial robotics platform featuring interactive Three.js 3D rendering and instant cost estimation.
6. **Smart Galla**: High-volume retail automation suite with offline-first PWA caching and thermal POS hardware sync.
7. **CivicTrack**: Hackathon-winning municipal grievance logging and resolution tracking portal.
